# 1.0.9 beta 4

This beta supersedes 1.0.9 beta 3 and focuses on compact layouts, clearer setup guidance, and
release-test hardening.

- Keep the Restore Defaults footer readable without overlap at the 560 px minimum width and 150%
  UI scale across all ten interface languages.
- Remove duplicated Steam setup guidance: the Steam step now uses a distinct status detail and no
  longer repeats its description as an action hint.
- Give translated Settings tabs and setup-wizard phase markers room to grow at high scale.
- Print the resolved XDG config and state paths when uninstalling, and cover upgrade/uninstall
  behavior with a preservation test.
- Cover updater checksum, missing-asset and missing-download failures, including verification that
  the installed application remains runnable.
- Automated coverage is now 174 tests (165 Core + 9 headless UI).

The installer archive remains self-contained, checksum-verified and installable without root.
